title: Energy Plot Description
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately describe the energy-versus-separation plot and its relation to the liquid-drop model.

title: Energy Release Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct equation for the energy released during fission.

title: Coulomb Barrier Explanation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must explain why elements heavier than iron but lighter than lead do not fission spontaneously.

title: Binding Energy Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should discuss the concept of binding energy and its significance in nuclear fission.

title: Liquid-Drop Model Reference
description: Important Criteria: The student should reference the liquid-drop model in relation to binding energy behavior.

title: Equation Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The student may include a clear explanation of the terms in the energy release equation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that units are consistent and correctly applied throughout the response.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in equations.
